description: This Swift source file defines an extension for the String type that adds a computed property `nonEmpty`. This property returns an optional String, which is nil if the original string is empty or contains only whitespace/newline characters after trimming; otherwise, it returns the trimmed string.

methods.name: nonEmpty
methods.description: A computed property that returns an optional string. It trims whitespace and newline characters, returning nil if the resulting string is empty; otherwise, it returns the trimmed string.
